title: Bhavya OS architecture
purpose: Show the institutional systems and their relationships for public, learner, and administrative audiences.
accessible_text: Bhavya OS connects public, learner, and administrative users to a Cloudflare application, Supabase authentication, Turso application data, Backblaze B2 assets, the GitHub canonical repository, GitHub Actions, and the OpenCode control plane. No credentials or internal URLs are shown.
